title: Big Sur Triptych
identity: Deon Nielsen Price’s Big Sur Triptych is a 1985 work for soprano saxophone or B-flat clarinet and piano, published by Southern Music in 1996. It lasts about nine minutes and has three movements: Sea Otters, Redwoods, and Crags. The composer’s performance archive and contemporaneous reviews document saxophone performances.

evidence.claim: Composer’s site gives instrumentation, date, duration, movement titles, 1985 first performance and recordings.
University library record confirms 1996 score and separate part pagination.
Composer performance archive lists Bill Wilson saxophone performance of Big Sur Triptych.
Composer-hosted review characterizes the first movement as detached and the second as lyrical, with abrupt phrasing in the third.

review_focus: Inference: the documented optional clarinet version and review-based contrasts invite checking the saxophone part for detached articulation and lyrical line across movements.
collection_flag: Alternate-instrument edition for soprano saxophone or B-flat clarinet with piano. The available records establish the paired options but do not establish which instrument was original.

listening.description: Composer archive documents saxophonists Bill Wilson and Paul Stewart performing the work.
listening.verification: Performance credits checked; audio playback not auditioned.

gaps: No public score pages inspected; original-instrument provenance remains unknown.
Composer archive lists performances, but accessible audio for this work was not verified.
proposed_corrections: Add piano to instrumentation and qualify soprano saxophone as an alternative to B-flat clarinet.
